# Power Interview AI

> Privacy-first, desktop AI interview coach and meeting note taker for Windows and macOS - spoken mock interviews with a scored report first, then live transcription, AI reply and code suggestions, and smart session exports for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

Power Interview AI is a standalone desktop application, not a browser extension or cloud service. All sensitive data (transcripts, screenshots) stays on the user's device by default. New users get a full 1-hour free trial with the product's free model, no practical rate limit. Paid plans add a SOTA (state-of-the-art) model, with the same practical absence of usage limits. The model is provided by Power Interview AI - there is nothing for the user to connect or configure. The app does two things, in this order. First, it runs its own spoken mock interview: an AI interviewer asks questions out loud, listens to the spoken answers, and produces a scored, exportable report; a mock session is priced per question, follow-up and report rather than per minute. Second, it assists during the real, live call with transcription and suggestions, metered per minute. Both halves read the same profile - the user's CV and the job description saved to their account. Payment is cryptocurrency-only - no credit card, PayPal, or bank details required. macOS builds are temporarily unavailable while the team works on bringing them back online; Windows is fully supported today.

## Product pages

- [Home](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/): overview, free trial offer, and product demo.
- [How it works](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/how-it-works): install, set up your CV and the job description, rehearse with a mock interview, then run the live call.
- [Mock interview](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/mock-interview): the in-app spoken mock interview - setup options, how a session runs, what the scored report contains, and how it is priced.
- [Features](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/#features): mock interviews, live transcription, AI reply suggestions, stealth mode, code suggestions, and meeting note export.
- [Languages](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/#languages): the full list of the 28 languages an interview can run in - English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Turkish, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Arabic and Hebrew. One setting drives transcription, live suggestions, mock questions, scoring and the exported report, and it can be changed mid-interview. The mock interviewer speaks its questions aloud in 7 of them (English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Japanese) and writes them in the other 21, with the scoring unchanged.
- [Pricing](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/pricing): free trial, credit-based paid plans, and cryptocurrency payment details.
- [Why Choose](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/#why-choose): how the combination of spoken mock practice and live in-call help compares with interview-practice tools and coding platforms, plus privacy and stealth-mode differentiation.
- [Benefits](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/#benefits): outcomes for job seekers using the product.
- [FAQ](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/faq): platform support, privacy model, billing, and usage questions.
- [Team](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/team): the developers building Power Interview AI.
- [Contact](https://www.powerinterviewai.com/#contact): support and community channels (email, GitHub, Telegram, X, Discord).
